Bank-Churn-AI-Advisor.desc: XGBoost model (AUC 0.91) predicts which bank customers will churn. SHAP explains why. Llama 3.1 via Groq then generates a personalised retention strategy per customer. Built with Streamlit, Optuna tuning, and deployable to Streamlit Cloud.

Multi-Agent-AI-Research-System.desc: ResearchMind is a quick‑and‑easy AI research tool. You type a topic, and four smart agents work together:  Search Agent – finds recent, reliable web pages about the topic. Reader Agent – opens those pages and pulls out the important text. Writer Agent – turns the gathered information into a clear, short report with an intro, key points,a conclusion

AI-Stock-Price-Predictor.desc: AI stock price predictor using ensemble of LSTM, Random Forest & XGBoost models. Fetches real-time data via Yahoo Finance, engineers 30+ technical indicators, and forecasts future prices for any stock, index, or crypto ticker. Built with Python, TensorFlow & Scikit-learn.
